'''Aleth Par''' was an individual who had an interest in the [[Heroes of Cularin]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Aleth Par was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In about [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], [[Merik Darou]], the assistant of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren|Lavina Wren]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], was hospitalized after consuming some tainted [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]]. Wren subsequently hired the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of local freelance agents, to track down the [[drug dealer]] from which Darou had obtained the drugs and obtain a sample of the substance, and the agents traveled to Darou's apartment in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Hedrett]] on Cularin. Par had an interest in the matter for his own personal reasons and for those of his employers, and he followed the agents to the apartment, tailing them from a distance. A short time later, the agents learned that Darou had purchased the drugs from the dealer [[Kelkan D'vrosh]], and Par again followed the agents from a distance as they headed for D'vrosh's apartment in the city [[Gadrin]]. Par arrived at the apartment before the agents and he found a broken [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] inside the building. He repaired the device and learned from it that D'vrosh had paid for a berth aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|star liner]] [[White Nova (star liner)|''White Nova'']]. Par then re-broke the datapad and waited in a nearby building, to see if the agents would pick up on the clues contained within the device.<ref name="OK" />

Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the gas [[Trinex-M]] was inadvertently dispersed in the city [[Oluna Biqua]] on the planet [[Genarius]], and the effects of the gas caused the city's population to gain [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]]. The Heroes of Cularin were sent by the city's [[comptroller]], [[Nestin Thokor]], to obtain a pure sample of the gas, and Par trailed the agents from a distance while they performed their mission.<ref name="NPLH" />

==Equipment==
Par wore a long black coat, a hooded, dark gray-colored [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]],<ref name="OK" /> and a black metal mask that obscured the upper half of his face.<ref name="NPLH" /> He carried a set of [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]].<ref name="OK" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aleth Par was created by [[August Hahn]] and appeared in the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] adventure ''[[Oblivion's Kiss]]''. The module portrayed Par as a mysterious character who had an interest in the player characters, the Heroes of Cularin, and it stated that Par was set to appear in future ''Living Force'' modules. Par later made a brief appearance the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[No Place Like Home]]'', which was also written by Hahn, which also stated that more about Par would be revealed in future ''Living Force'' adventures. However, none of the subsequent ''Living Force'' modules included any mention of him. While neither ''Oblivion's Kiss'' of ''No Place Like Home'' explicitly confirmed Par's [[Species/Legends|species]], ''No Place Like Home'' stated that he was possibly [[Human/Legends|Human]].
